title: chore(tools): replace tslint by typescript-eslint
body:
**Summary**

TypeScript support was added to `eslint-config-algolia@13.3.0` ([changelog](https://github.com/algolia/eslint-config-algolia/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#1330-2019-04-16)), allowing us to drop TSLint and use ESLint to lint both JavaScript and TypeScript files.

* Update `eslint-config-algolia` to `v13.3.0`
* Enable `algolia/typescript` configuration
* Remove TSLint
* Update `lint` and `lint:fix` npm scripts to only use ESLint on JavaScript and TypeScript files
* Update files to match new rules:
  * Update ignore comments to target the new ESLint rules
  * Add return type to functions (new `@typescript-eslint/explicit-function-return-type` rule)
  * Update naming of generic type variables (new `@typescript-eslint/generic-type-naming` rule)
  * Fix errors in TypeScript files (not validated by ESLint before)

**Result**

Tooling only, no changes are visible to the users.
For developers the development environment is simplified with one less tool to setup.
